utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I'll mark it down. I like to be punctual.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, glad you got it down. See you Saturday at 10!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, see you then. I'll be there a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, so it's on Sunday now? That works for me—I can bring that rusty saw I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think Vik said Saturday, but maybe it got moved? Let me double-check with him.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I thought Tess said Sunday—maybe I mixed it up again? I'll just bring the saw whenever it is.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, let's start by making a list of common repairs needed in the neighborhood. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good idea, but let's be specific about what tools each repair requires.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, like if someone needs a loose railing fixed, we'd need a screwdriver and maybe a level.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's our neighborhood tool repair event this Saturday. Folks bring in broken tools and we fix 'em up together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's so handy! Do you know if anyone there can fix lamps? I've got one that's been flickering.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the playground. I think I have a wrench somewhere—I'll check when I get a minute.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, a wrench could be handy. And hey, if you see anyone who can fix lamps, let me know—mine's been flickering.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I'll ask around about lamps. Gotta run—let me know if you find that wrench.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let me check our supply list—we should have some nails and wood from last time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, we've got basic tools from Faye too! Be sure to tell everyone to bring their broken stuff on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got the nails and wood noted, and I'll remind folks to bring their broken items on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane! The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center. Will you be able to make it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday works for me. I'll be there, maybe a bit late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane! We'll save a seat for you. See you Sunday!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm pretty sure it's still on, but let me double-check with Quinn to be certain.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, let me know when you find out. I've got my toaster ready!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, I'll text Quinn right now!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what parts you'll need? I might have some spares.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure yet, I'm still figuring out what's broken.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright. Do you have a ballpark budget for the repair?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I heard about it. I think it's at the community center, but I'm not sure about the time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's Saturday at 10 am. Let me go confirm.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks for checking. I'll wait to hear from you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I was thinking of getting the kids involved.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Saturday 10am. Good idea to bring the kids, they can learn.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'm glad you're on board! Do you think your kids would like to help with painting or maybe organizing the tools?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Is that something people actually do around here?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely! It's a great community thing. And I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, moved to Sunday? Are you sure? I haven't seen any updated notices.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Gus! I've been meaning to check what supplies we have for the repair drive. Let me dig through the shed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo. Let me know if you need any of my tools—I've got 'em ready for Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks Gus! I'll take a look—hopefully we've got enough paint and bolts, but your tools will definitely help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I think they're fixing up the playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Saturday at 10. We're fixing stuff together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, see you there! I might bring a flickering lamp to see if anyone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I heard it might be at the community center, but I'm not sure about the time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, it's at the school playground this Saturday at 10 AM, not the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, thanks for the correction, Faye! I'll make a note of the school playground at 10 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mina! The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday? What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm not sure about the exact time yet—I just heard about the day change. I'll let you know when I find out more!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's a community event where we fix broken items together—like your blender! Saturday at 10am at the school playground.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I see. My blender is on the fritz, so that'd be perfect. I'll bring it Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mina, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I have a rusty saw that needs fixing. Did they move it to Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday? I thought Quinn had the schedule. Let me check with them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Did we talk about that already?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, we did. I was wondering if anyone can fix lamps—mine's been flickering.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, any update on that repair drive? I'm swamped but want to help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I thought it got postponed—are you sure it's still happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, really? I thought it was still on—I better double-check.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sam, do you know what items are needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm not sure of the exact list, but I can check with Faye or the organizers and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, thanks Sam. Let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? I think it's going to be a great chance to fix up some things.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'll be there! I've been telling everyone about it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great! Vik is coming too, and I heard Pia is wondering about tools—might be good to bring some if you have extras.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, Rosa mentioned it's actually on Sunday at the community center now. So I can make it after all.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Sunday at the community center? That's good to know. But have we sorted out who's bringing the tools yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Leo mentioned he has a set we can borrow. I can ask him if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina! Actually, the drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center. Are you still planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sunday at the community center? Got it, I'll be there with my toaster!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Vik! See you Sunday—I'll bring some extra wiring just in case.
